messages:
ara: Noticed a surge of failed OIDC token introspections and missing audit.trace_id in the auth logs starting ~03:05 UTC. Some tenants reporting SCIM sync backlog too. Anyone oncall? :mag:

maria: oncall. seeing lots of 401/400 from idp-api when we call /introspect. Error snippets show audience mismatch and 'unable to unwrap key: envelope key not found'.

kevin: we did a KMS rewrap last night for extid keys and also switched the alias naming scheme in infra-templates. Could be some workers still using old alias string.

samir: I pulled a couple of raw responses from idp-api: ```{
  "error": "invalid_token",
  "error_description": "audience \u003d 'https://redwood/api' not equal to token.aud \u003d 'https://redwood'"
}```

olivia: interesting. we also started seeing SAML metadata fetch failures where entityID in metadata had trailing slash removed by a proxy. Downstream RBAC checks look up principals by entityID exact-match so this could break session creation and audit linking.

ara: so two correlated flakes: (1) KMS alias mix causing unwrap errors -> introspect failures; (2) entityID canonicalization mismatch causing sessions to be created without the tenant tag -> missing trace_id in audit.

maria: agree. logs: KMS UnwrapEnvelopeError spiked at 03:04:56 across scim-syncers and idp-proxy. Around same time, auth-service emitted WARN tenant_lookup: 'entityid not found'.

kevin: quick remediation options: A) recreate old alias pointing to current CMK (fast) B) re-deploy workers with forced alias config (safe) C) add middleware to canonicalize entityID (code change). I propose A+monitor, then B during low-traffic window, and schedule C as follow-up.

ops-bot: quickrun: created rollback job to restore alias alias/extid/old -> cmk-0a1b2c. ETA 2m.

maria: doing canary restart of one scim-syncer to ensure it picks up alias change.

samir: can we also backfill audit.trace_id for the missing window? The events exist but lack correlation id because middleware failed after unwrap. Scripting a best-effort backfill might help customers and incident analysis.

kevin: I started INFRA-4500 to prevent alias deletions until all revisions confirm. Adding a gating check in rollout pipeline to validate alias presence before cutover.

olivia: added a short-term mapping in auth-service to accept entityID variations (with trailing slash/no-slash) so RBAC lookups succeed. Will roll this as a hotfix but will gate with feature flag.

maria: after alias restore, KMS unwrap errors dropped to baseline in ~90s, introspection 200 responses resumed for most tenants. SCIM backlog started draining.

ara: severity and follow-ups: - Sev3 (partial auth provisioning outage) - Postmortem (why alias variable propagated unevenly) - Add alert for UnwrapEnvelopeError spike - Ensure correlation_id assignment is earliest in request path - RBAC: make entityID matching tolerant + add canonicalization test in CI.

samir: vuln note: an attacker manipulating entityID or forcing alias flip could attempt to induce auth failures -> DoS for provisioning. Recommend threat model update and mitigations.

kevin: filed CHORE-7812 to add alias presence gate in rollout and to add a pre-deploy KMS validation step to infra pipeline.

ara: thanks team. jess/sales product should get a short customer-facing timeline. I'll start the incident doc and assign action owners. closing when doc and tickets are linked. :white_check_mark:
